added: In-game MOD panel (F2 to toggle, Tab to switch pages): the mod list shows every loaded mod's name, version, DLL, GUID and hotkeys, read-only
Keyboard map draws your layout and highlights keys live; click a mod pill to show only that mod's keys, or hold a key to see what it does
New layout button column on the right of the keyboard map (60 / 65 / 75 / TKL / 98 / 104); one click switches the layout and remembers it
fixed: Pressing Z / C / V / F6-F9 or another mod's hotkey while the panel was open could trigger that mod's UI
changed: While the panel is open, the other mods' plugins are paused, the game's input actions are disabled and Keyboard.current is patched to null; the panel's own key reading is unaffected
Keyboard layout is no longer auto-detected: it defaults to 104 and can be switched any time from the buttons on the right
removed: Removed the first-run layout chooser card
